title: Submission now hard-requires reference_contact_choice, but the only UI that submits it is deferred to RC1.2 (still backlog)
evidence:
+  // Reference-contact choice (AD-2 / amendment A4): an explicit attested or
+  // declined answer is required — no silent skip, no default. The radio card
+  // UI lands in story RC1.2; the server-side contract is fixed here so the
+  // write path always records a deliberate choice.
+  let errors = case get_form_value(values, "reference_contact_choice") {
+    "attested" | "declined" -> errors
+    _ -> [
+      #("reference_contact_choice", "Choose one option to continue."),
+      ..errors
+    ]
+  }
…
+  rc1-1-attestation-capture-schema-submission-write-path: review
   rc1-2-attestation-ui-the-references-section-choice: backlog
detail: Every real submission fails validation until RC1.2 ships the radio card; the sprint file keeps rc1-2 in backlog while rc1-1 enters review. Deploying RC1.1 alone bricks the public apply form with an unfixable error.
recommended_fix: Gate deployment: merge and deploy RC1.1 and RC1.2 together, or tolerate a missing field server-side until the UI lands, then enforce the requirement.

title: Overlong-header truncation test uses ASCII only; the multi-codepoint case that can still trip the CHECK and 500 the write path is untested
evidence:
+    |> simulate.header("x-forwarded-for", string.repeat("9", 500))
+    |> simulate.header("user-agent", string.repeat("U", 600))
…
+  summary: request_helpers.client_ip/client_user_agent slice by graphemes (Gleam string.slice) while the DB CHECK bounds count characters (Postgres length()) — a multi-codepoint header can exceed the bound post-slice and 500 the write path.
detail: The new truncation test asserts length()==64/512 with single-codepoint repeats, so it cannot catch the grapheme-vs-codepoint mismatch the diff's own deferred-work entry admits can exceed the Postgres length() bound post-slice and 500 submissions.
recommended_fix: Make request_helpers slice by codepoint (matching Postgres length()) and add a multi-codepoint header case to the overlong test so the deferral can't regress silently.

detail: Three contradictory states in one diff: spec 'done', its own verify-contract test task unchecked, sprint 'review'. The tests plainly exist in the diff, so the tracking artifacts, not the code, are stale.

evidence:
+- Existing ack-count tests (no_guarantor 2, with_guarantor 3, co_applicant 3) keep their counts by giving `apply_form_fixture_values` a `choice` parameter defaulting to declined; the attested path gets its own dedicated tests.
…

+    // keep their focus on the guarantor conditional; the attested and
+    // missing-choice paths get their own dedicated tests.

detail: Spec says a fixture parameter; the diff adds a hard-coded list entry and tests map over it to flip values. Callers keep two labeled args (email, has_guarantor). Behavior matches; the documented mechanism does not.
recommended_fix: Either add the choice parameter as specified, or correct the Design Notes to describe the hard-coded default with per-test override.
